images.caption: Figure 1:(a) Unified forecasting.LO-World jointly encodes occupancy and LiDAR into a shared BEV latent, forecasting both modalities through a single generative process.(b) Performance comparison.Under comparable control conditions, LO-World achieves a10.9%10.9\%relative improvement in 4D IoU and a30.1%30.1\%reduction in Chamfer Distance over prior state-of-the-art baselines.

Figure 2:Overall architecture of LO-World.Our framework consists of two components: (1) LO-VAE, which jointly tokenizes occupancy and LiDAR into a unified BEV latent space; and (2) LO-Former, a flow-matching-based generation framework that efficiently generates future unified BEV latents from Gaussian noise.

Figure 3:Qualitative forecasting on nuScenes.(a) LiDAR and occupancy forecasts at 2, 4, and 6 s versus OpenDWM andI2I^{2}-World, respectively. (b) Paired forecasts under straight, right-turn, and left-turn ego-vehicle trajectories.

Figure A1:Examples with higher and lower JC. Each row pairs occupancy and LiDAR views from one example. For each modality, we show ground truth (GT), prediction, and their superimposition. The associated JC score is shown at the right.
Figure A2:Occupancy, LiDAR, and RGB views for three scenes.

Figure A3:Two failure cases under reverse ego-motion trajectories. The cases are shown side by side, with occupancy and LiDAR predictions paired in adjacent columns. Successive frames run from top to bottom.
